# visit-pitfall-guest (format: runtime/input.h): console 1 of the two-console scene visit-pitfall,
# from the guest-tools save. As visit-house-guest to 26400; then the visitor's lid closed from
# 26460 (LID) and opened, the battery low from 26910 (LOWBAT; the player warns, A at 27110 ends
# it): the host sees the other console's player sleep and warn. Then the visitor takes the
# shovel from its pockets (the pen, about 27150-27300), walks east off the stones, digs a hole
# (A at 27838) and fills it again, digs again, buries the pitfall seed from the pockets in it
# (about 28100-28300) and waits beside it for the host to fall in; then it takes the net from its
# pockets and swings it. Then it drops the apple from its pockets (about 32100) and takes it up
# again by B (32336: the host sees the other console's player pick it up), drops it once more
# (about 33300) and walks north; the host walks over it. Then the visitor takes the rod from its
# pockets (about 33950), walks east to the river and casts (A at 35145), reels in (35949), takes
# the axe (about 36100-36400) and swings it three times at the tree west of it (36519-36687).
